name: Slow Cooker Chipotle Pulled Pork
ingredients: 1/2 tablespoon adobo sauce from a can of chipotle peppers in adobo sauce
4 pounds pork shoulder, excess fat removed
Whole-wheat or gluten-free hamburger buns or lettuce wraps (serve-with)
unmapped: coconut-sugar (1 Tbsp across batch; smoked-paprika maps to board 'paprika')
why: Verified from source page: 428 cal, 27g protein, 3g total carbs per serving (nutrition is for the pork itself, buns/garnish optional) - low in band on cal, essentially zero-carb. Whole pork shoulder, slow-cooked and shredded, in lane. Structurally low-carb (pork + chipotle/aromatics); serve over cauliflower rice or in lettuce for the meal-prep dinner. chipotle-adobo, coleslaw-mix, tabasco, paprika all on board; coconut sugar is a tiny genuine gap. Distinct from catalog 'slow-cooker-pork-tinga-bowls' (tinga is tomato-chipotle rice bowl) - this is a dry chipotle pulled pork.
